en.headline: Three vehicles collide on Cheung Tung Road near Sunny Bay
en.dek: Police said a taxi driver was briefly trapped after a light goods vehicle, a private car and a taxi collided in Tung Chung on Sunday afternoon.
body: Police said three vehicles collided on Cheung Tung Road in Tung Chung on Sunday afternoon, leaving a taxi driver injured and briefly trapped.

Officers received a report at about 3:30pm that a light goods vehicle, a private car and a taxi had collided in the area, RTHK reported. The taxi driver was hurt and trapped, then freed. Two ambulances were sent to the scene.

Other reports said a light goods vehicle and a taxi had met head-on near the Sunny Bay salt-water pumping station, and that a second driver was also hurt and remained conscious. Accounts differed on how many people were injured and which hospitals they were taken to. This report uses the police account given to RTHK.

The collision closed both directions of Cheung Tung Road near Sunny Bay for a time, and Discovery Bay resident bus routes DB03R and DB03P were diverted. RTHK traffic news later said the road had reopened in both directions near Sunny Bay by 5:17pm, and that the affected bus routes were returning to normal.

zh.headline: 東涌翔東路三車相撞 的士司機一度被困
zh.dek: 警方表示，星期日下午一輛輕型貨車、私家車及的士在翔東路一帶相撞，的士司機受傷並一度被困，其後獲救。
body: 東涌星期日下午發生三車相撞，一名的士司機受傷並一度被困，其後被救出。
港台引述警方表示，下午約三時半接報，一輛輕型貨車、一輛私家車及一輛的士在東涌翔東路一帶相撞。的士司機受傷，一度被困，其後獲救。當局派出兩輛救護車到場。
其他報道指，意外發生在翔東路近欣澳海水抽水站，輕型貨車與的士迎頭相撞，另一名司機亦報稱被困受傷，兩人清醒。各報道對傷者人數及送院地點說法不一，本文以警方向港台交代的情況為準。
意外一度令翔東路來回方向近欣澳灣全線封閉，愉景灣居民巴士DB03R及DB03P號線須改道。港台交通消息其後表示，下午五時十七分左右，翔東路近欣澳灣來回方向已經解封，受影響巴士路線陸續回復正常。
